Chapter 1104: 27 Chaos Secret Patterns (Request Subscription)

Chapter 1104: Chapter 27 Chaos Secret Patterns (Request Subscription)

Ding Seven War Front area.

Lin Yuan soon arrived at the war front area he was to guard.

The war front, formed by the intersection of Qingfen Domain and Purple Dream Domain, is very long, and each Great Lord needs to guard the corresponding war front area.

Resisting enemy attacks.

The war front area where Lin Yuan is stationed, located at the edge, is not the target for attack by Purple Dream Domain’s veteran Great Lords and peak Great Lords, who mostly choose to attack those core war front areas.

This is why Lord Qingfen believes that the opponent Lin Yuan needs to face will be Thunder Spear Great Honored.

Among the Great Lords currently revealed by Purple Dream Domain, there are only two or three new Great Lords, with Thunder Spear Great Honored most likely to attack the Ding Seven War Front.

Of course, it’s just most likely, not necessarily Thunder Spear Great Honored.

But even if it’s another Great Lord, it would be a similarly tiered new Great Lord. As for veteran or peak Great Lords?

For a veteran Great Lord or peak Great Lord to attack the edge defense line is a complete waste, even if they break through, what then?

The impact on the overall war is minimal. After all, it’s just the edge defense line, and Qingfen Domain can completely adjust in real-time.

But the core defense line is different. Once the core defense line set up by Qingfen Domain is breached, the war situation will be overwhelmingly tilted.

If Purple Dream Domain deploys a veteran Great Lord or peak Great Lord to attack the edge defense line, Lord Qingfen would be delighted.

With one less veteran Great Lord or peak Great Lord attacking the core defense line, Qingfen Domain’s pressure would reduce significantly.

“In this battle, Qingfen Domain will focus primarily on defense, and Red Pine King should lean towards being ‘conservative’.

Lin Yuan thought to himself that through Lord Qingfen’s arrangements for the war situation, one could discern the thinking of ‘Red Pine King’ behind the scenes.

Lin Yuan quite agrees with this; Spirit Might King is currently too prominent, and confronting them head-on at this moment? There’s no benefit.

As long as the first few waves of attacks from Purple Dream Domain can be held off, the war situation will naturally reverse, and then whether to invade Purple Dream Domain will entirely depend on Red Pine King.

“Greetings, Great Lord.”

“Greetings, Great Lord.”

Soon after Lin Yuan arrived at the Ding Seven Defense Line, several figures came to meet him.

Lin Yuan was in charge of guarding this war front area, naturally, he was not the only one.

Numerous battle machines were ready for Lin Yuan to deploy at any time.

In wars between major domains, if not at the level of Great Lords, it’s basically all centered around battle machines.

Self-Dao Realm, Dominator-level powerhouses differ too much in strength compared to Great Lords, only by utilizing battle machines can they barely threaten Great Lords.

Thousands of Dominator-level powerhouses, using the power of battle machines to strike, with quantitative change causing qualitative change, can even make a Great Lord change color.

“Let’s discuss the situation.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the several respectful figures standing there.

These figures all possessed peak Dominator-level strength and could be considered his subordinates stationed at this defense line.

“Great Lord, we currently have one B-rank medium battle machine, six B-rank lower battle machines, and thirty-six C-rank upper, middle, and lower battle machines.”

The leading figure, adorned with a single horn and named Luo Peng, respectfully reported to Lin Yuan.

Battle machines are divided into three tiers: A, B, and C.

C-rank battle machines can accommodate dozens up to hundreds of Dominator-level figures, and the combined power they unleash can slightly restrain a Great Lord.

B-rank battle machines have distinctions of upper, middle, and lower, with capacity for thousands to tens of thousands of Dominator-level powerhouses.

As for A-rank battle machines, they accommodate over ten thousand Dominator-level powerhouses, and the strike they unleash must be seriously regarded even by peak Great Lords.

The Ding Seven War Front is located on the edge, and its highest tier battle machine is only B-medium.

As for B-upper and A-rank battle machines, they’re basically in core defense line areas; such battle machines are extremely precious, appearing only on the most important battlefields.

Of course, preciousness is one aspect, whether there are so many Dominator-level powerhouses is another aspect.

This time the war with Purple Dream Domain superficially appears as Qingfen Domain versus Purple Dream Domain, but in actuality, it has gathered all the elites from several dozen surrounding major domains, making it a relatively high-intensity war.

“Battle machines…”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

It’s said that above A-rank battle machines, there are even higher tier machines accommodating Great Lord-level powerhouses.

“As for specific deployments, you can handle them as you see fit.”

“If there’s an attack from a Great Lord-level enemy, I will engage.”

Lin Yuan said plainly, without delving into details.

As the overseer of this defense line, Lin Yuan just needs to grasp the overall situation.

“Understood.”

The horned man Luo Peng respectfully responded.

“By the way.”

“Take me to see the battle machines.”

Lin Yuan looked at the horned man Luo Peng, speaking calmly.

“See the battle machines?” The horned man Luo Peng had no doubts and immediately said: “Great Lord, please follow me.”

Soon.

Lin Yuan arrived before a massive battle machine.

This battle machine was a C-rank battle machine, able to accommodate three hundred sixty-eight Dominator-level figures.

The entire battle machine, rising several million kilometers high, once three hundred sixty-eight figures enter, the machine fully operates, and its size can grow a hundred-fold to a thousand-fold.

“Is this the battle machine?”

Lin Yuan carefully observed, the surface of the battle machine covered with countless secret patterns, precisely through these secret patterns that the power of hundreds of Dominator-level figures could be fully combined.

Hundreds of Dominator-level figures each walking different paths, their powers converging without causing collisions or even explosions is fortunate, still combining?

And if this only resulted in the fusion of hundreds of Dominator-level powers, it would far from threaten a Great Lord.
